Custom Software Engineering

Custom software, engineered to last.

We design and build web applications, SaaS platforms, and backend systems around how your business actually operates, with code your team can understand, extend, and own.

Discuss Your ProjectHow we work

Capabilities

  • Full-stack web applications
  • SaaS product development
  • Backend systems and APIs
  • Web and mobile applications
  • Product and technical discovery
  • Code health and handoff

What we deliver

Focused capabilities, delivered by experienced engineers.

  • Full-stack web applications

    Customer-facing products, portals, and internal applications with responsive interfaces and dependable backends.

  • SaaS product development

    MVPs and core platform features, including accounts, roles and permissions, multi-tenant data models, and billing integrations.

  • Backend systems and APIs

    Services and APIs with clear contracts, predictable performance, and straightforward integration for internal and partner use.

  • Web and mobile applications

    Focused mobile and cross-platform experiences built on the same APIs and business logic as your web product.

  • Product and technical discovery

    Requirements, architecture options, and a phased delivery plan before you commit to a major build.

  • Code health and handoff

    Automated tests, documentation, and a deliberate handoff so your team can confidently run what we build.

When teams bring us in

Common starting points.

  • You need to take a validated idea to a production-ready MVP.
  • Your core platform needs new capabilities faster than your team can deliver them.
  • A critical process runs on spreadsheets and email and deserves real software.
  • An existing application has become hard to change and needs a sound foundation.

What you can expect

  • Source code in repositories you control
  • Architecture overview and decision records
  • Automated tests and a CI pipeline
  • Deployment and operations documentation
  • A prioritized backlog for what comes next

Our approach

From first conversation to production.

  1. 01

    Discovery and scope

    Users, workflows, constraints, and success criteria, distilled into a focused first release.

  2. 02

    Architecture

    Technology choices that fit your product, your team’s skills, and your hosting environment, with decisions documented.

  3. 03

    Iterative delivery

    Working software every iteration, demonstrated to you, with code review and automated tests as standard.

  4. 04

    Release and handoff

    Deployment, monitoring, documentation, and knowledge transfer to the people who will own the system.

Questions

Common questions.

More answers on our FAQ page.

Who owns the code?

Ownership and IP terms are set in the contract. We prefer to work in repositories you control, so the code, its history, and its documentation stay with you.

Can you work with our existing codebase?

Yes. We start with a codebase review covering structure, test coverage, and deployment, then agree on conventions with your team before making significant changes.

Which technologies do you use?

We choose technologies that fit your product, your team’s skills, and your hosting environment, and we document why. If you have an established stack, we work within it.
